selection: Three positive examples chosen retrospectively from307 benchmark-comparable accounts. This is a curated historical showcase, not all accounts, a complete performance history, or current performance.
methodology: Account return and own-window SPY copied from the dated receipt; excess is the difference in percentage points. Different windows are not one portfolio. Simulator and broker-paper evidence remain separate.
